title: scorer.md frontmatter
description: A judge that grades the runs of some agents. The folder name is the scorer name. The body of the file is the judge prompt. This schema checks the YAML frontmatter of scorers/<name>/scorer.md.

description.description: One line that says what the scorer grades.

agents.description: The agents whose runs the scorer grades.

items.description: The name of a folder in agents/. A lowercase kebab-case name.

judge.description: An id in models.yaml, or the name of the person who grades.

labels.description: The grades that the judge picks from. At least 1 label passes and at least 1 fails.

value.description: The label that the judge returns. Lowercase, with - or _ between words.

passingScore.description: A run passes when its label scores this or more.

samplingRate.description: The percent of runs that the scorer grades.
